A type of '''corvette''' was built by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was bronze-skinned with a pointed prow which split into a pair of mandibles. Two of the corvettes were used in an ambush upon the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Pengalan IV]], during the [[Battle of Pengalan IV|battle]] there between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
